goal: Your receptionists answer the same questions about check-in, transfers, breakfast and the beach many times a day. At night guests wait until morning for a reply. The assistant will answer in English, German and Russian from your hotel info at any hour and pass booking requests to reception.
solution_items: A Telegram assistant that answers guest questions from your 12-page hotel PDF
Replies in English, German or Russian, whichever the guest writes in
Transfer requests collected in the chat and added to your Google Sheet
Booking questions handed to reception with the full conversation
Staff can update the hotel info themselves, no developer needed

relevant_cases.why_relevant: It also answers from a knowledge base and scores each answer for accuracy.
One assistant serves both guests and staff of a hospitality business.

stages.name: MVP: answers from hotel info
stages.content: RAG over the hotel PDF with answers in three languages in Telegram
stages.tier_reason: An LLM over your own data, no external integration yet.

stages.name: Transfers and reception handoff
stages.content: Transfer requests go to Google Sheets, booking questions go to staff
stages.tier_reason: One simple integration on top of a working bot.

stages.name: Testing and handover
stages.content: Testing on real guest questions, a short guide for reception, access handover

next_step.start: within 2 business days after we agree on terms
client_needs: Access to the transfers Google Sheet
A Telegram account for the hotel bot

optional_blocks.reason: The season deadline is fixed, so progress needs to be visible at every stage.
